backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access-controlled user profiles and per-user generation history with add, fetch, and delete operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping high-level product features to frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Textual mapping of frontend file paths to their concise functional descriptions for reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind and OKLCH color-system stylesheet defining theme variables and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document that mounts the React application and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router and layout setup defining routes for all tool pages and user history.
frontend/src/components/GeneratedAssetCa: Reusable UI card showing generated media with loading overlay and optional download button.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Internet Identity login/logout button managing authentication state and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal prompting new authenticated users to enter their name before using the app.
frontend/src/components/RequireAuth.tsx: Wrapper component enforcing login and showing a sign‑in prompt when unauthenticated.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, copyright year, and a caffeine.ai referral link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Provides the site header with logo, navigation links, login button, and responsive mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/ToolCard.tsx: Displays a card for a tool with icon, description, and a link button to start using it.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth state, providing login, logout, and identity context to the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for user profiles and generation history, using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, dark mode overrides, and font imports.
frontend/src/lib/clientImageGen.ts: Generates a deterministic abstract image from a prompt using canvas drawing and seeded randomness.
frontend/src/lib/clientVideoGen.ts: Generates a short animated particle video from a prompt using canvas, seeded randomness, and MediaRecorder.
frontend/src/lib/historyAssetStore.ts: Provides IndexedDB helpers to save and retrieve Blob assets using a generated asset ID.
frontend/src/lib/voiceover.ts: Wraps the Web Speech API to play, pause, resume, and stop text-to-speech with optional callbacks.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React, sets up React Query and Internet Identity context, and renders the App.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Renders the homepage with hero content, navigation buttons, and cards linking to AI tool pages.
frontend/src/pages/MyHistory.tsx: Displays and manages the user's generation history, including previews, deletion, and asset retrieval from IndexedDB.
frontend/src/pages/TextToImage.tsx: Generates images from text prompts, displays results, and saves assets and metadata to user history when logged in.
frontend/src/pages/TextToVideo.tsx: Generates short videos from text prompts, shows previews, and stores generated video assets and metadata when authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/TextToVoiceover.tsx: Converts text to speech using selected browser voices, manages playback state, and logs voiceover metadata to history.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from storage or the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, extended theme settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project's state, goals, features, and image requirements for building a free AI‑tools website for Pixel Nova Digitals.
